post.description: Only terminal or retryable states can be reset; a currently active job cannot be duplicated.

get.summary: List all orders

post.summary: Create a POS order
post.description: POS-only contract. The server controls the source and unit prices; marketplace orders must arrive through the internal connector boundary. An optional unitPrice is an expected-price check, not an override.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable key reused for retries of this exact order request

post.summary: Move a paid POS order to the next lifecycle status
post.description: Base chain only: CONFIRMED -> PACKED -> SHIPPED -> DELIVERED. Invalid jumps and unpaid orders are rejected. Use /handover for counter handover.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable key reused for retries of this transition

post.summary: Mark a packed, paid order as shipped
Record POS payment and finalize stock deduction
post.description: CASH records the cash received and change; BANK_TRANSFER records staff confirmation with an optional reference. An absent body keeps the legacy manual-confirmation behavior. The server computes the amount due.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable key reused for retries of this payment confirmation

post.summary: Hand a paid POS order to the customer at the counter
post.description: Moves CONFIRMED -> DELIVERED without requiring PACKED or SHIPPED.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable key reused for retries of this handover

post.summary: Cancel an unpaid POS order
post.description: Releases only the reserved quantity. Paid-order cancellation/refund is deliberately blocked until a later phase.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable key reused for retries of this cancellation

post.summary: Confirm sale of held stock
post.description: Decrements both on-hand and reserved simultaneously

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable key reused for retries of this exact sale confirmation

post.summary: Hold stock for a transaction
post.description: Increases reserved count without decreasing physical on-hand

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable key reused for retries of this exact reservation

post.summary: Release held stock
post.description: Returns reserved count to sellable pool

post.summary: Trigger manual expiration sweep of active holds past TTL
Cancel hold immediately
Confirm and execute a previewed allocation
post.description: Rechecks the previewed inventory version and allocation revision, then starts Decrease -> verify -> Increase delivery. Requires an Idempotency-Key.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable key reused for retries of this exact confirmation

post.summary: Preview a manual quota allocation
post.description: Stores a projected plan with the inventory version and allocation revision it was built from. Preview never changes on_hand, reserved or any listing quota.

post.summary: Adjust inventory with reason
post.description: Admin-only manual balance adjustment with version concurrency control

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable key reused for retries of this exact adjustment

post.summary: Verify the WooCommerce connection through the live wc/v3 API
post.description: The channel becomes CONNECTED only after the backend reads products from the store. Inventory writes remain disabled unless the dedicated write flag is on.

503.description: Connector is disabled or not configured

422.description: Channel is not a development/test channel

502.description: WooCommerce rejected the request or returned invalid data

504.description: WooCommerce timed out; result is uncertain

post.summary: Disconnect a WooCommerce channel locally
post.description: Clears connection verification metadata but keeps mappings and evidence. No remote store data is changed.

get.summary: Get product variant listings mapped to this channel

post.summary: Register (but do not verify) an external listing identity for a SKU
post.description: Allocation requires a mapping that has been verified through the channel adapter.

post.summary: Verify a registered external listing through the channel adapter
post.description: Verification is fail-closed for channels without a writable, read-back capable connector.

post.summary: Reconcile a listing against the channel's independent read
post.description: Uses the simulator when explicitly enabled; real channels without a connector remain fail-closed with 503. Drift is recorded as evidence and queues a correction job.

503.description: Channel delivery and verification are unavailable

post.summary: Inject a bounded simulator fault
post.description: Fault types: REFUSE, TIMEOUT, TIMEOUT_AFTER_WRITE, WRONG_READ, DELAY, DUPLICATE.

delete.summary: Clear any simulator fault for a listing

post.summary: Mobile bearer session login (unsupported)
Invalidate active session
Web session login with CSRF token issuance

source.description: Deprecated compatibility field. Only POS (or empty) is accepted.

external_order_id.description: Must be empty. Marketplace identity is assigned by the internal connector boundary.

unit_price.description: Optional expected price. The server price is authoritative; a mismatch is rejected with PRICE_OR_STOCK_CHANGED.

reason.description: Optional reason stored in the order history.

cash_received.description: Only for CASH: the amount of cash the customer handed over.
